content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Structured Query Language (SQL)
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL Data Manipulation Language (DML) Commands
    - Lesson 3: Working with Tables and Databases in SQL
    - Lesson 4: Data Retrieval with SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 5: SQL WHERE Clause for Filtering Data
    - Lesson 6: Joins (INNER, OUTER, LEFT) in SQL for Combining Tables
    - Lesson 7: Using SQL Functions for Advanced Operations
    - Lesson 8: Stored Procedures and Triggers
    - Lesson 9: Optimizing SQL Queries Performance
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Database Design and Normalization

  Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Python Data Structures (Dictionaries, Lists)
    - Lesson 2: Working with Pandas DataFrames
    - Lesson 3: Data Cleaning Techniques in Pandas
    - Lesson 4: Handling Missing Values and Outliers
    - Lesson 5: Time Series Analysis using Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Mathematical Functions for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 7: Statistical Analysis with Python and SciPy
    - Lesson 8: Data Visualization with Seaborn
    - Lesson 9: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Techniques
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Machine Learning Algorithms for Prediction

  Track: Intermediate SQL (Advanced Queries)
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Aggregation Functions in SQL
    - Lesson 2: Common Subqueries and Correlated Subqueries
    - Lesson 3: Using SQL Views
    - Lesson 4: JSON Data Types in SQL
    - Lesson 5: Transaction Controls and Locking
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Join Techniques (UNION, FULL OUTER JOIN)
    - Lesson 7: Optimizing SQL Performance (Indexes, Partitioning)
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Database Optimization Strategies
    - Lesson 9: Advanced Data Modeling and Normalization
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Big Data Databases (NoSQL, Hadoop, etc.)

  Track: Intermediate Python (Data Engineering)
    - Lesson 1: Working with Big Data using Apache Spark
    - Lesson 2: Distributed Computing Concepts in Spark
    - Lesson 3: Advanced Data Manipulation with PySpark
    - Lesson 4: Handling Large Scale Data Cleaning using PySpark
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Apache Hadoop and HDFS
    - Lesson 6: Stream Processing with Apache Kafka
    - Lesson 7: Big Data Storage Solutions (HBase, Cassandra)
    - Lesson 8: Data Integration Techniques for Big Data
    - Lesson 9: Real-time Data Analytics and Dashboards
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Cloud Services for Big Data (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  Track: Data Analysis with Excel
    - Lesson 1: Intermediate Excel Functions and Formulas
    - Lesson 2: Pivot Tables and Data Summarization
    - Lesson 3: Data Visualization in Excel
    - Lesson 4: Advanced Data Cleaning Techniques in Excel
    - Lesson 5: Power Query for Data Import and Transformation
    - Lesson 6: Data Validation Rules and Conditional Formatting
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Power BI for Interactive Dashboards
    - Lesson 8: Basic Statistical Analysis with Excel
    - Lesson 9: Forecasting Techniques in Excel
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to VBA for Macro Programming
